title: Jamie Dimon says AI will shorten work week to 3.5 days, cure cancer
summary: Speaking with "CBS Evening News" anchor Tony Dokoupil, JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon shared an optimistic outlook on the future of artificial intelligence. "I believe that 30 years from now, your kids are probably working three and a half days a week. They'll probably live to 100," Dimon said.
